reviews.t: I've been looking for a better way to keep my makeup handy in my bathroom ...
reviews.x: I've been looking for a better way to keep my makeup handy in my bathroom without it being in a bag or ugly plastic drawers and this has been a good answer. It holds a good quantity for me and it's great for my lipsticks and brushes. It also allows me to keep my lotions handy. The open compartments on the top just lay on the top of the drawers can could come apart depending on desire of look. reviews.t: This is very sturdy and comes in two pieces
reviews.x: This is very sturdy and comes in two pieces. I purchased this hoping that I could store my essential oils in it. it is too small for that, but it works great for nail polish and supplies.  I received this product for a discounted price in exchange for my honest review

I would like to start by saying I am giving this 3 stars because I didn't realize that the first 2 rows don't have anything holding them on, so when I received my amazon package I took this out and those rows just fell off. If I hadn't opened it on carpet it definitely would have broken. Now for the good stuff, I like that it is clear and has several compartments so I can fit all of my makeup and I can also fit a lot of my jewelry, also it isn't cheap and is made with very sturdy material. reviews.t: Beautiful!!!  My daughter & I love them!!!
reviews.x: I bought two of these.  One for me and one for my daughter.  Both of us love them!  They're very beautiful & look like crystal.  All of my makeup brushes fit well & I love the individual lipstick partitions.  The drawers are nice too & open quite easily.  The drawers have a velvet piece of fabric in them that can be easily removed if you don't want it or want to replace it with another color & makes it easy to wash.  My foundation fits well in the larger receptable too.

I was orginally thinking "ughh $15.99 for something to hold makeup". Once I got it though I can totally understand it! Make from really thick plastic and great quality. I want to order more just for like office storage. It was also a bit bigger then I thought. So if you have a tight area this might not work for you. But other wise, it is a great find.

reviews.t: Good for organizing makeup and knick knacks on vanity tops
reviews.x: Good for organizing makeup and knick knacks on vanity tops, one on the bathroom counter and one on the makeup vanity. Nicely made without any sharp edges and all drawers fit the way they should. Will purchase more to give as gifts as these are well made and just right to fit on nightstands and table tops, keeps things organized very nicely.

Great addition to my space. I love the quality of this organizer and it holds quite a bit without taking up a lot of space. The drawers come with liners to prevent scratching the bottom and the top part which is detachable fits nicely and holds bruses, moisturizer, lipstick etc. I will definitely be getting another one.

Very high quality. Thick, sturdy, cosmetically appealing. Wish the drawers were a little wider for bigger cosmetics, but overall an excellent product. Still cant believe the price on this, very well worth it!

reviews.t: Very nice quality material but just too small for my needs. The drawers are very shallow.
reviews.x: The quality is nice but for me it's rather small. I did see the measurements before ordering but due to the nice thickness of the plastic the drawers are just not deep enough to hold much.  Would be nice for someone with small amount of makeup possibly young teenager. The top section is fine for lipsticks and small brushes and few bottles of foundations but the drawers are really shallow. They fit mascaras and small eye shadow, blushes and compacts. Overall though the quality is very nice and th

reviews.t: Exceptional quality and came packed so nice much better than other more expensive brands I bought
reviews.x: Exceptional quality and came packed so nice much better than other more expensive brands I bought. The entire unit was shrink wrapped to prevent moving in the original box from manufacturer which is a thoughtful detail I appreciate to better ensure nothing gets chipped or broken in transit. The lining in the drawers of course are removable. And I find ample room in the top slots for nearly all lip stick sizes save for the more square fatter ones. And there is surprisingly  good room in the drawe

I previously kept all my makeup in a bag and had to dig thru the bag to find everything. This allows me to have every makeup item in a readily available position. I also like it because I can stand my brushes up in here after cleaning to dry!!!  If organization is calling you and you want to get rid of that dreaded makeup bag, (with eyeshadow and foundation all over the bag), this is a great buy.  I am also thinking of purchasing another for my jewelry. Yes it is that versatile!!!

reviews.t: Love this. Thought it would be bigger
reviews.x: Love this. Thought it would be bigger, but now Im glad it wasnt. Its just the right size. Holds all my makeup. Everything I have was in a makeup bag before and I had to dig for what I wanted. Now, I just easily look and grab. It comes in two parts that nices nestle on top of each other and dont slip apart. There are nice black 'velvet' sheets in each drawer. Really well done. Would buy again!

I don't know why I didn't make this purchase years ago! I've seen some reviews say the drawers stick too much, but I disagree. Keep in mind this storage unit is plastic, some sticking is bound to happen but its not excessive. The black velvet that comes with it is a little cheap, certainly wouldn't maintain the same integrity if it were to be washed.

Such an amazing makeup organizer and everything fits perfectly! The right size and perfect to be organized. I love it because now I can find my makeup easier and all my brushes and everything fits good. I would totally recommend if you want to be more organized and not be looking through your makeup bag.😂 I would buy again

I was a little hesitant to purchase this organizer due to the cost. It however is worth every penny! I love all the different features and will purchase more in the future.  I am a member of a few beauty boxes each month and this organizer has helped me sort a lot of my makeup so I can better find what I am looking for.

Saw this on a lightening deal, I had been wanting one but did not want to pay the $25 the stores wanted, so when it saw it for $13 I jumped on it.  It is very well made and fits my stuff nicely!  I'm glad I got it.  I just wish the little lipstick squares were deeper, they are pretty shallow, but I still love it!!

I really like this make up organizer! It's a lot sturdier than I thought it would be and very nice to look at. It holds a lot of stuff in the top part. I do wish the bottom drawers were a bit deeper to hold more stuff but over all I really like this product. Packing and shipping was amazing!!!

reviews.t: Great way to keep the bathroom counter organized
reviews.x: Great way to keep the bathroom counter organized.  There are a few slots for "taller" make up items but I wish there were more.  Brushes, eye liner, mascara, etc. are all fairly tall items and many of the slots are made for lipstick length items.

Bought this for my girlfriend. She's a cosmetologist. Now she has her own little station in my house. Only thing she complain about is that they don't lock into one other. If a kid were tonbe in the room and knock it over, it'll all fall apart.

I am very happy with this purchase. The quality really made me happy I never purchased an acrylic makeup storage set before but I'm glad I gave this one a shot! It's not to big plenty of room to add lipsticks, makeupbrushes,, etc

This is very cute. And I like it a lot. I just wish it had more longer spots to put eyeliner etc. In and not as many lipstick ones as I don't wear lipstick and the spots are to small for most other items.
This thing is fabulous. I was looking for something to store make up and jewelry. I use the drawers for my favorite daily pieces of jewelry and the upper storage compartments for makeup and brushes.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the organizer's sturdy, thick, high-quality acrylic construction.
Many customers say it holds a good amount of makeup and brushes while taking up little counter space.
Several reviewers find it too small or the drawers too shallow for their needs.
Some reviewers note the top rows or pieces are detachable and can fall off, which is a concern.
Reviewers commonly describe it as beautiful and cosmetically appealing.
